mines.mine_notes: Underground mine, Caeté Complex, Minas Gerais. 2025: 370,253 t milled @ 3.77 g/t, 89.21% recovery. Pilar was the company's sole operating asset in 2025. LOM plans indicate 5 years of sustained production from 2025. Ore hauled ~40-45 km to Caeté plant (720 ktpa design capacity; gravity + flotation + flotation-concentrate leach + CIP).

mines.mine_notes: Underground mine, MTL Complex. Operations suspended December 2024 (Satinoco tailings pile incident) and remained suspended throughout 2025; ANM authorization to lift restriction received early January 2026; restart commenced March 9, 2026. Restart capex: paste fill plant and filtration unit recommissioned; tailings placed as underground mine backfill.
mines.reserve_tonnes_mt_note: Orebodies A, B & C: 1,225 kt @ 3.26 g/t Au (A 29 koz @ 3.95; B 30 koz @ 3.04; C 70 koz @ 3.12)

mines.mine_notes: Mineralized zone within MTL Complex. Faina test work and plant results indicate potential for improved metallurgical recovery over prior testwork; production ramp-up resuming concurrent with Turmalina restart. Reserves unchanged at 160 koz.

Development project within MTL Complex; environmental licensing progressing. Acquired from IAMGOLD; held via wholly owned Mineração Onças de Pitangui Ltda. Positions MTL Complex to deliver production beyond 2030. Reserves 284 koz Probable (SLR NI 43-101 technical report, March 2026).
Caeté Complex mine on care and maintenance since 2018; also hosts the 2,200 tpd Caeté processing plant. No mineral reserves estimated for Roça Grande.
Paciência Complex mine and plant on care and maintenance since 2012. In 2025 preparatory activities began toward a potential restart in H2 2026, supported by the gold price.

notes: FY2025: revenue $135.2M (down 15% on 41% fewer ounces sold), average realized gold price $3,421/oz (+43% YoY). Consolidated cash operating costs $1,277/oz sold; AISC $1,931/oz sold (vs $1,651 in 2024), driven by fixed/G&A costs fully allocated to Pilar as sole operating asset. Net loss $15.8M incl. $51.2M Satinoco incident expenses (full year). Average BRL/USD in 2025: 5.59 (vs 5.39 in 2024). All amounts in USD. Exploration properties within complexes: Pontal, Aparação (MTL); Morro da Mina, Boa Vista, Juca Vieira, Sabara Extension, Lavra Velha, Zé Firme (Caeté); Chamé, Marzagão, Bahu, BIF North, Quati, Córrego Brandão (Paciência).
